summary.reference: unchanged from source; verify EEG sidecar
summary.filter: causal Butterworth order 4 bandpass 0.5-30 Hz; 10 s warm-up
summary.psd: Welch Hann 2 s / 50 percent overlap; nonoverlapping 4 s analysis windows
summary.qc: heuristic amplitude/flatness and BAD annotations, not validated artifact detection
limitations: Pilot segment only; no whole-recording conclusion.
No ICA or automatic artifact correction. No electrode impedance or true SNR measurement.
Peak alpha candidate requires review; no clinical cutoff.
No ERP: resting-state recordings do not supply a controlled time-locked stimulus experiment.
No diagnosis/classifier/connectivity inference. Reference and volume conduction affect channel relationships.
Replay is precomputed offline; not a tested live acquisition pipeline.
